provenance_note: Full frozen capture_manifests records (the actual stage/boundary capture-record identity the V5 harness emits: per-stage record_count plus the ordered record_sha256 capture lists) for every case, BOTH arms, recovered read-only on 2026-09-08 from the contemporaneous chain-case summaries on inferswarm01. The harness emits lists; both lists are retained verbatim and equality is derived, never stored. out_dir and tag are storage labels that legitimately differ between arms (different output roots and run tags) and are retained verbatim; the reducer compares record_count and record_sha256 per stage.
record_convention: stage1/stage2 = first/middle stage capture manifests (armed per case via CASE_ARM); stage3 = last-stage consumer-boundary capture manifest (CASE_BEGIN per case). record_sha256 is the ordered list of per-record SHA-256 identities as persisted by the frozen harness.
